purpose: Implement and validate distinct oracle low-rank reconstruction and deployable normalized-parameter-to-rawData ridge components without changing frozen v4/v5 evidence or enabling posterior exploitation.

public_component.configuration_path: explicit keyword-only factory arguments in submit/optimization.py
public_component.rank_policy: Reject requested rank below one. Clamp each field to min(requested rank, field width, max(1, training row count minus one for PCA or training row count for SVD)); publish requested and effective ranks plus the reason.
public_component.nonfinite_policy: Reject the complete fit when any normalized parameter or main-array training value is non-finite; never silently drop a row or field.
public_component.constant_policy: Retain constant and near-constant fields. PCA coefficients are zero around the training mean; SVD uses the uncentered matrix. A single PCA row produces a mean-only reconstruction with effective rank zero.
public_component.schema_policy: Require one exact selector set and frozen main shape/dtype, axes, units, metadata, and parameter normalization identity. Reject missing, extra, complex, object, structured, or schema-drifting fields.
public_component.uncertainty_policy: Deterministic prediction reports zero-width cost intervals and exposes no posterior/readiness capability.

mathematics.pca: Per field, subtract the training coordinate-wise mean, fit a truncated low-rank basis, encode centered rows, and add the same mean during inverse transform.
mathematics.svd: Per field, fit the truncated low-rank basis to the uncentered training matrix; encode and inverse-transform without a learned mean.
mathematics.basis_canonicalization: For every basis vector, make its largest-absolute-loading entry positive. Compare reconstruction/projection/subspace behavior rather than elementwise bases near repeated singular values.
mathematics.ridge: Fit one deterministic multi-output ridge map from normalized parameters to each field's coefficients. Include an unpenalized intercept only when fit_intercept is true. Use stable linear least squares and no scikit-learn dependency.

solver_resource_audit.decision_rule: Use NumPy exact SVD only if both cells finish within both stops and no slower than 2x Torch low-rank. Otherwise select Torch low-rank. A timed-out or memory-stopped exact cell is an explicit rejection, not missing evidence.
solver_resource_audit.selection_basis: The 2000x26645 exact wide decomposition must materialize substantially more state than a rank-32 solver; the bounded audit may confirm or reject this choice without opening scientific test evidence.

evidence_partition.fit_inputs: Only frozen training rows and their real recorded normalized parameters/rawData.
evidence_partition.validation_use: Validation rawData is accepted only after fit. Oracle arms may transform it; deployable arms use it only for after-the-fact metrics.
evidence_partition.test_use: No test locator may be opened until a later version seals legal test evidence and all acceptance thresholds.
evidence_partition.tie_break: No automatic rank or alpha search is performed in v11. Every arm uses its explicit fixed values.

metrics.required_gap: Report deployable minus same-decomposition oracle field-macro error; never aggregate oracle and deployable rows into one performance mean.

stop_conditions: Stop a cell on missing/extra fields, schema or parameter-normalization drift, non-finite fit input, invalid rank, backend absence, publication failure, or invalid current-cost projection.
Retain every failed arm and diagnostic. Do not tune rank, alpha, solver, thresholds, or split after validation/test access.
Do not launch a simulator, formal benchmark, or long training under this preregistration without separate user authorization.
